operator: SWP Stadtwerke Pforzheim GmbH & Co. KG

officialEvidence.operatorStatement: SWP operates most public charging stations in Pforzheim and activates/payment through the SWP Autostrom app.
officialEvidence.officialPriceLead: A SWP press page states an Autostrom-app price of 0.39 EUR/kWh, but the publication predates the current 2026 verification and does not establish a universal direct/ad-hoc tariff for every station.

stationEvidence.observation: Current third-party station sources show SWP-operated DE*SPF EVSEs and station-level direct-payment values around 0.48 EUR/kWh on some AC points. These are discovery evidence only and are not promoted to a network tariff.

decision: Operator identity and DE*SPF station mapping are supported, but the current 2026 universal direct-payment tariff is not authoritatively published. Keep station-level values separate and defer network pricing until a current SWP checkout/app or QR/public backend exposes exact per-EVSE prices.
